set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KWYS7H6C4XP4GGERQXXMH98S. Add the first Ariadne-backed fixture harness for structural semantics before porting algorithms broadly. Target fixtures: conn_set undirected edge order, conn_rect_set rectangular order, directed lag edge handling, weighted_cor invariants, and one cor_lw or event-weighted correlation fixture. Acceptance: fixtures are committed in a portable form, tests run on JVM and JS, and the harness documents which Ariadne behavior is contractual versus merely R API surface.
set.title: Connectivity parity fixture harness for Ariadne core semantics
